done_means: The bracket holds the 2 kg motor at 80 mm reach without breaking under 3g load (19.6 N downward) with a safety factor of 1.5.
The peak stress in the arm and wall plate stays below the yield strength of aluminium divided by 1.5.
The tip deflection under load is less than 1.2 mm.
The total mass of the bracket is no more than 57.1 grams.
All features are thick enough to mesh well and avoid stress concentrations.
